Sandbox_AtfCasino_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for the whole mod, off by default. While off the Creepy Spiffos are not shown at all and the tables are dead: no right-click menus, and the server refuses every wager. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_BlackjackEnabled_toolt: Lets players sit at the Creepy Spiffo Dealer's blackjack table. Bets use the Minimum/Maximum Bet limits.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_MinBet_tooltip: Smallest wager the server will accept on any game.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_MaxBet_tooltip: Largest wager the server will accept on any game.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_BlackjackBetWindowSeco: After the first bet of a round, how long other seated players have to place theirs before the cards are dealt. Default 20.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_BlackjackTurnSeconds_t: How long each player has to hit, stand or double on their turn. Running out of time stands the hand. Default 20.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_BlackjackRoundPauseSec: How long the finished hands stay on the table before the next betting round opens. Default 8.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_RouletteEnabled_toolti: Lets players sit at the Creepy Spiffo Croupier's roulette wheel (European, single zero). Each chip uses the Minimum/Maximum Bet limits.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_RouletteBetWindowSecon: After the first chip of a round hits the board, how long everyone has to place bets before the wheel spins. Default 30.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_RouletteSpinSeconds_to: How long the wheel spins before the ball drops and bets are paid. Default 6.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_RoulettePauseSeconds_t: How long the result stays on the board before the next betting round opens. Default 8.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemEnabled_too: Lets players sit at the Creepy Spiffo Poker Dealer's no-limit Texas Hold'em table. A hand only starts once at least two seated players have chips.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemBigBlind_to: Big blind posted each hand; the small blind is half. Buy-in limits are expressed in big blinds. Default 1000.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemMinBuyInBli: Smallest stack a player can sit down with, in big blinds. Default 20 (20,000 Scraps at the default blind).
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemMaxBuyInBli: Largest stack a player can have on the table through buy-ins, in big blinds. Winnings may grow a stack past this. Default 100.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemTurnSeconds: How long each player has to fold, check, call or raise on their turn. Running out of time checks if possible, otherwise folds. Default 20.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemPauseSecond: How long the finished hand stays on the table before the next one can start. Default 10.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_TexasHoldemStartDelayS: Countdown from the moment two or more seated players have chips until the cards are dealt, so late arrivals can still buy in. Default 5.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_FloorZ_tooltip: Floor (level) all five Creepy Spiffos stand on. -1 is the first basement level. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_GuardLeftX_tooltip: World tile X the left armed guard stands on. Changes apply live - edit from the admin panel and the guard moves within a second.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_GuardLeftY_tooltip: World tile Y the left armed guard stands on. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_GuardLeftFacing_toolti: Compass direction the left guard faces while standing at their post. North is up-and-right on screen (the direction the in-game compass calls north). Default South. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_GuardRightX_tooltip: World tile X the right armed guard stands on. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_GuardRightY_tooltip: World tile Y the right armed guard stands on. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_GuardRightFacing_toolt: Compass direction the right guard faces while standing at their post. North is up-and-right on screen (the direction the in-game compass calls north). Default South. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_DealerX_tooltip: World tile X the blackjack dealer stands on. The blackjack table follows. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_DealerY_tooltip: World tile Y the blackjack dealer stands on. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_DealerFacing_tooltip: Compass direction the blackjack dealer faces while standing at their post. North is up-and-right on screen (the direction the in-game compass calls north). Default South. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_CroupierX_tooltip: World tile X the roulette croupier stands on. The roulette table follows. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_CroupierY_tooltip: World tile Y the roulette croupier stands on. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_CroupierFacing_tooltip: Compass direction the roulette croupier faces while standing at their post. North is up-and-right on screen (the direction the in-game compass calls north). Default South. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_PokerDealerX_tooltip: World tile X the Texas Hold'em dealer stands on. The poker table follows. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_PokerDealerY_tooltip: World tile Y the Texas Hold'em dealer stands on. Applies live.
Sandbox_AtfCasino_PokerDealerFacing_tool: Compass direction the poker dealer faces while standing at their post. North is up-and-right on screen (the direction the in-game compass calls north). Default South. Applies live.
